field_restricted_acquisition_specs.rule: POST exactly one declared GraphQL query per pinned study UUID. Join case_id/case_submitter_id to the separately allowlisted biospecimen roster. If a study UUID changes, a query returns extra keys, or case linkage and tumor_grade cannot be returned together, do not broaden the query; mark that stratum BLOCKED.

before_any_value_or_frequency_is_read: Fetch each field-restricted response in a standalone acquisition process that cannot import or open any molecular artifact.
Validate that every returned record has only the exact allowed keys and the requested clinicalAttributeId.
Record URL or GraphQL query, retrieval UTC, HTTP headers or PDC study version, byte size, and SHA-256 in experiments/taskB_grade_histology/INPUTS_LOCK.json.
Run the acquisition twice and require byte identity or a documented stable canonicalization with identical canonical SHA-256.
A different API response version is not auto-accepted; re-pin before audit.
acquisition_lock_rule.on_extra_field_or_mixed_payload: Do not inspect values. Quarantine the file outside the analysis input directory and set BLOCKED.
acquisition_lock_rule.on_missing_field: Set the variable/cohort BLOCKED; do not open a broad supplement to recover it.

forbidden_content_classes: expression matrices or expression-derived patient covariate values
coefficients, d values, confidence intervals, p values, q values, or direction calls from prior analyses
any clinical payload containing survival, recurrence, treatment response, or molecular-result fields alongside grade or histology

process_controls.open_file_audit_method: Use strace openat tracing or an equivalently complete OS-level file-open log; if unavailable, set BLOCKED.
process_controls.static_scan_before_run: Reject scripts containing a forbidden absolute path, filename class, target-result keyword, numpy load of npy/npz, parquet result read, or recursive directory scan.
process_controls.stdout_rule: Do not print patient-level values. Only aggregate clinical-only Phase-1 tables may be emitted after INPUTS_LOCK exists.
process_controls.access_log: Append every file open and network source to RESEARCH_ACCESS_LOG.tsv or the experimenter successor log with action, purpose, hash, and firewall decision.

attestations_required: I did not open or load any molecular score, expression matrix, target result, coefficient, effect-size table, figure, manuscript, or Task A scientific artifact.
Every input byte read is either SHA-pinned above or was acquired by an exact field-restricted specification and locked before values were inspected.
No clinical category, exclusion, collapse, or mapping was selected after a molecular outcome was seen.
Unknown and conflicting annotations remained missing.
If clean separation failed, I stopped and returned BLOCKED.
refusal_rule: If an allowed clinical field cannot be obtained without opening a mixed file or broad payload containing forbidden outcomes, do not read that source. Return BLOCKED for the affected variable/cohort.
